versions.content: Log messages with a LogLevel lower than the configured value of LogChannel threshold for the identified LogChannel shall be discarded and E_OK shall be returned. This shall only be done if this holds true for every LogChannel the LogMessage is assigned to.

Log messages with a log level numerically higher than the configured value of LogChannel threshold for the identified LogChannel shall be discarded and E_OK shall be returned. This shall be done on each LogChannel from the list of output LogChannels for the Log Message, considering [SWS_Dlt_00665].
